name: Domain Restoration with Semantic Mirroring
description: The previous draft drifted into a discrete-slot injection model which changed the mathematical nature of the problem, causing a gate rejection. This rewrite restores the true original domain (factory flow-shop) while perfectly mirroring the deductive structure of the seed's certificates. By removing the discrete packet/firewall terminology but keeping the logical requirements identical, it tests whether the models can derive the three scalar bounds from standard scheduling constraints without relying on memorized router/firewall patterns.
